trigger: Target status 1.5, or 2 straight from active, while any linked NCR is not Closed OR any counted input has no saved non-empty value (spec 125 FR-019, FR-021). Resubmission after being sent back is checked the same way (FR-023). No override for any role (FR-022).

response_409_open_ncrs.missing_inputs: [{ name, label }] — present, possibly empty, when any input is missing a value

response_409_inputs_missing.message: string — 'Every input needs a value before this traveler can be submitted.'

compatibility: Additive. OPEN_NCRS keeps its meaning and its open_ncrs field. Callers that branch on the code they already know are unaffected. A caller that submits a traveler with a blank input now receives INPUTS_MISSING (409). This is a behaviour change, documented in CLAUDE.md and tools/openapi/openapi.yaml.
